unsustainable--adj.def: Impossible to continue without causing harm.
unsustainable--adj.ex: The level of fishing is unsustainable.

exhibitionist--noun.def: A person who behaves so as to attract attention.

ruthlessness--noun.def: The quality of acting without pity.

candidly--adv.def: In an honest and direct way.
candidly--adv.ex: She spoke candidly about the failure.

nondescript--adj.def: Having no interesting or unusual features.
nondescript--adj.ex: He drove a nondescript grey car.
nondescript--adj.exTr: Göze çarpmayan gri bir araba sürüyordu.

principally--adv.def: Mainly, more than for other reasons.
principally--adv.ex: The fund helps rural schools principally.
principally--adv.exTr: Fon başlıca kırsal okullara yardım ediyor.

versatility--noun.def: The ability to be used or to work in many ways.
versatility--noun.ex: The versatility of the tool surprised us.

naivety--noun.def: A lack of experience that makes you trust too easily.

constraint--noun.def: Something that limits what you can do.

wickedly--adv.def: In a mischievous or very bad way.

exhilaration--noun.def: A feeling of great excitement and energy.
exhilaration--noun.ex: The exhilaration of the descent stayed with him.

oddity--noun.ex: The clock is a local oddity.

synopsis--noun.def: A short account of the main points of a story.
synopsis--noun.ex: Read the synopsis on the back.

zany--adj.def: Funny in a strange and unexpected way.
zany--adj.exTr: Gösterinin delice komik bir mizahı var.

undaunted--adj.def: Not discouraged by difficulty or danger.

seedling--noun.def: A very young plant grown from a seed.

comprise--verb.def: To consist of, or to make up a whole.

amply--adv.ex: The results amply justify the cost.

cessation--noun.def: The stopping of an activity, in formal English.
cessation--noun.ex: They called for a cessation of fighting.

ceaseless--adj.ex: The ceaseless noise wore us down.

abstraction--noun.def: A general idea separated from real examples.

gape--verb.def: To stare with your mouth open in surprise.
gape--verb.ex: The children gaped at the elephant.

ferociously--adv.def: In a violent and fierce way.

lethargy--noun.def: A lack of energy and enthusiasm.

restorative--adj.def: Making you feel healthy and strong again.

innovate--verb.def: To introduce new methods or ideas.
innovate--verb.exTr: Küçük firmalar daha hızlı yenilik yapıyor.

physicality--noun.def: The physical strength and presence of a person.
physicality--noun.exTr: Rol gerçek bir bedensel güç istiyor.

acoustically--adv.def: In a way relating to sound.

adjoin--verb.def: To be next to and touching something.

allege--verb.def: To say something is true without proving it.
allege--verb.exTr: Rapor ciddi hatalar olduğunu iddia ediyor.

amplification--noun.def: The making of a sound louder, or of an idea fuller.

animatedly--adv.def: In a lively and interested way.

anticlimactic--adj.def: Disappointing after a build-up of excitement.

apt-to--verb.def: Used with be to say someone is likely to do something.
apt-to--verb.ex: He is apt to forget names.

baldly--adv.def: In a plain direct way with no softening.
baldly--adv.ex: He put it baldly: we had failed.

beguilingly--adv.def: In a charming way that may mislead.

believably--adv.def: In a way that can be believed.

benignly--adv.def: In a gentle and harmless way.
benignly--adv.ex: He smiled benignly at the children.

blankness--noun.def: The state of showing or containing nothing.
blankness--noun.ex: The blankness of the page frightened her.

blithely--adv.def: In a happy way that ignores the danger.

bulk-up--verb.def: To make your body bigger and more muscular.
bulk-up--verb.ex: He bulked up before the season.

bureaucratically--adv.def: In a way involving many official procedures.

characterization--noun.def: The way a writer creates the people in a story.

chauffer--noun.def: A person employed to drive someone's car, a variant spelling of chauffeur.
chauffer--noun.ex: The chauffer waited by the gate.

chauffer--verb.def: To drive someone about as their paid driver.
chauffer--verb.exTr: Bütün hafta sonu konuklara şoförlük yaptı.

chiselled--adj.def: Having clear sharp lines, said of a face.

climactic--adj.def: Forming the most exciting point of an event.
climactic--adj.ex: The climactic scene lasts ten minutes.

compliantly--adv.def: In a way that obeys without objecting.

conditionally--adv.def: Only if certain things happen first.

conscientiously--adv.def: In a careful and thorough way.

consultancy--noun.def: A company that gives expert advice.

contextual--adj.def: Relating to the situation in which something happens.

contextually--adv.def: In relation to the surrounding situation.

cost-effective--adj.def: Giving good value for the money spent.

credential--noun.def: A qualification that proves you are able to do something.
credential--noun.ex: Bring every credential to the interview.

credibly--adv.def: In a way that can be believed.

cynically--adv.def: In a way that assumes selfish motives.

damply--adv.ex: The clothes hung damply on the line.

daunt--verb.ex: The size of the task did not daunt her.

demographically--adv.def: In terms of the structure of a population.

demography--noun.def: The study of populations and how they change.

detrimentally--adv.def: In a way that causes harm.

detritus--noun.def: Waste material left after something has been destroyed.

digitalization--noun.def: The process of changing records into computer form.

digitalize--verb.def: To change information into a form a computer can store.

disillusionment--noun.def: The feeling of learning that something was not as good as you believed.

dismally--adv.def: Very badly, or in a depressing way.

dither--verb.def: To hesitate because you cannot decide.

diverge--verb.def: To go in different directions, or to differ in opinion.
diverge--verb.ex: The paths diverge at the bridge.

divergence--noun.def: A difference between two things that were once alike.
divergence--noun.ex: There is a clear divergence of views.

divergent--adj.def: Going in different directions or becoming different.
